title: Money transfers
description: Move US dollars in from a bank account and back out by bank transfer or wire.
goal_template: A money transfers app. Customers sign up, move US dollars in from their own bank account and back out to it by bank transfer or wire, see the amount, the fee and when it arrives before they confirm, and follow each transfer's status until it settles.

screens.title: Transfers
screens.purpose: Every transfer with its amount, fee and status, from the lifecycle events api/ receives on Mynt's webhook.

screens.title: Sign up
screens.purpose: Onboarding: the product's journey, with its consents, required documents and the provider's hosted identity checks.

screens.title: New transfer
screens.purpose: Choose the direction and the amount, see the fee and the arrival time from the offer, then confirm in the provider's hosted flow.

flows.title: Make a transfer
steps: read the offer (offers) for the fee, the limits and the arrival time
show the amount, the fee and the required documents verbatim (documentShown) before the customer confirms
start the provider's hosted transfer flow (startAction) and send the customer to its redirect_url
api/ follows the transfer's status from Mynt's webhook (verifyWebhook) until it settles or fails
